objective: From the event-triggered Work, open ChatGPT Web with the native Work Cloud Browser. If authentication is required, request the native user-visible secure sign-in/takeover surface and stop there. The purpose is only to test whether the hidden/event-triggered Work can surface a human-interaction entry to the user.
allowed_actions: open https://chatgpt.com in native Work Cloud Browser
request native secure sign-in/takeover UI if available
record non-secret evidence/state/receipt on PR #6 branch
prohibited_actions: start Jules or any external provider/model
persist takeover URLs, cookies, tokens, passwords, MFA codes, session IDs, chat IDs, browser-control tokens, or other credential/session material
success_condition: A native secure sign-in/takeover entry is actually surfaced to a user-visible ChatGPT surface. Do not infer visibility from intent alone.
blocked_condition: If the native user-visible entry cannot be requested, is not surfaced, or visibility cannot be verified from the executor side, record BLOCKED or UNKNOWN; do not retry.
human_observation_needed: User should only report whether a new visible approval/sign-in/takeover entry appeared; no credential entry is requested by this probe.
